item.title: Darius Acuff Jr. named Sporting News First Team All-American
item.description: FAYETTEVILLE – Arkansas freshman Darius Acuff was selected first team All-America by The Sporting News, it was announced today. He joins Corliss Williamson (1995) as the only Razorbacks to be named first team All-America by The Sporting News.
